title: Custom styles odt 001
notes: real ODF named styles: named paragraph styles in styles.xml office:styles: "GP Body" (style:family="paragraph", fo:font-size 12pt) and "GP Head" (family paragraph, style:parent-style-name="GP Body", bold 16pt), applied from content.xml via text:p text:style-name (named, not automatic, styles). None of the five normative ODF counters match style elements, so feature counts stay 0; reference text is every visible paragraph string (style names themselves are not visible text).
